selection.unitRule: (dt_eqp, product, core_lot, core_slot) group with dt_log rows (dt_x/dt_y/c_bn/core_x/core_y all non-null) AND an exactly-matching (core_lot, core_slot) in core_wafer_map
selection.emitted: ALL units satisfying the unit rule at ANY row count, because the requested >=100 threshold is unsatisfiable on this box (largest unit has 94 rows). Per-unit counts are included so consumers can re-filter; no threshold of my own invention was applied.
selection.matching: exact string equality on core_lot and core_slot; no notation normalisation applied (dt_log carries drifted forms such as 'CL_2601_001' and slot '9' that core_wafer_map does not have)
selection.metaKeys: server/config/table_config.json map_key_columns: dt_log = [dt_lot, dt_slot], core_wafer_map = [core_lot, core_slot], joined by '_'

queries:
SELECT dt_eqp, product, core_lot, core_slot, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM dt_log
WHERE dt_x IS NOT NULL AND dt_y IS NOT NULL AND c_bn IS NOT NULL
  AND core_x IS NOT NULL AND core_y IS NOT NULL
  AND core_lot IS NOT NULL AND core_slot IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dt_eqp, product, core_lot, core_slot
ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT dt_eqp, product, core_lot, core_slot, dt_lot, dt_slot, dt_x, dt_y, c_bn, core_x, core_y
FROM dt_log
WHERE dt_x IS NOT NULL AND dt_y IS NOT NULL AND c_bn IS NOT NULL
  AND core_x IS NOT NULL AND core_y IS NOT NULL
  AND core_lot IS NOT NULL AND core_slot IS NOT NULL

SELECT core_lot, core_slot, core_x, core_y, c_bn
FROM core_wafer_map
WHERE core_x IS NOT NULL AND core_y IS NOT NULL
SELECT map_pk, target_table, map_id, grid_metadata FROM wafer_map_metadata
